name: panel
description: Panel review by five non-Claude models. Fans one high-stakes question out to deepseek-flash / nemotron / glm / kimi / minimax in parallel at full reasoning effort — each on its own configurable endpoint and key — with tools to read your repository and check the live web, then reconciles the answers into a position matrix, consensus graded by how independent it actually is, adjudicated disagreements, lone insights, and an explicit not-covered-not-verified section. Requires the llm CLI and your own API key — see README.
